name: atb-ai-agent
description: Local MVP / Proof of Concept for a secure AI banking assistant for ATB.

scripts.dev:verbose: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "api,ai,web,widget,pay,doc,atb,apt,acc" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green,red,cyan,yellow,red,gray,white" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:widget" "npm run dev:pay" "npm run dev:doc" "npm run dev:atb" "npm run dev:apt" "npm run dev:acc"
scripts.dev:combined: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix "[{name}]" --names "api,ai,web,widget,pay,doc,atb,apt,acc" --prefix-colors "blue,magenta,green,red,cyan,yellow,red,gray,white" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:widget" "npm run dev:pay" "npm run dev:doc" "npm run dev:atb" "npm run dev:apt" "npm run dev:acc"
scripts.dev:web: cd web-client && npm run dev -- --clearScreen false
scripts.dev:widget: cd widget-agent && npm run dev -- --clearScreen false
scripts.logs: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$files=@('logs/agent.log','logs/architecture.log') | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ }; if ($files.Count) { Get-Content $files -Wait } else { Write-Host 'No logs found yet. Send a chat request first.' }"
scripts.logs:errors: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path logs/errors.log) { Get-Content logs/errors.log -Wait } else { Write-Host 'logs/errors.log does not exist yet.' }"
scripts.test:all:once: node scripts/validate-site-index.js site-context/atb.tn/site-index.json && npm --prefix backend-node run test:all:once
